newsitem.title: CHINA: China power firm to offer 150 mln yuan bonds.
newsitem.headline: China power firm to offer 150 mln yuan bonds.

text.p: China's Beijing International Power Development Investment Co plans to issue 150 million yuan ($18 million) worth of three-year bonds, an official with the offer's underwriter said on Wednesday.

The bonds, which will carry annual interest of 11 percent, will be issued over a one-month period starting March 20, said an official of China Xinda Trust and Investment Co, the sole underwriter of the issue.
"Many non-bank financial institutions and firms have already placed their orders," the official said. "But some bonds will still be available to individual investors."
Proceeds will be used to finance a hydroelectric power plant and a thermoelectric plant on the outskirts of Beijing, he said.
Bond issuers plan to list the debt on one of the country's two stock exchanges -- either in Shanghai or Shenzhen, but still require listing approval from securities regulators, the official said.
